description: The OEE Sieve (from Eliahou 2023, Lemma 2.9) exploits that if a Collatz sequence from m has a run of odd steps followed by >= 2 even steps, then m's trajectory joins that of (m-1)/2. When (m-1)/2 < n, this eliminates n. Detected via a finite automaton on the step sequence.
mathematical_formalization: If T^k(n) = m and there exist l > 0 odd steps followed by >= 2 even steps from m, then trajectory of m joins T^{l+2}((m-1)/2). Prune when (m-1)/2 < n. State machine: {INIT, ODD_RUN, EVEN1, EVEN2_PRUNE}.
analogical_connections: Protocol state machines in network verification
implementation_hypothesis: 2-bit state machine alongside recursive traversal: state = (in_odd_run, seen_one_even). Reset on odd, increment on even, prune when both flags set and (m-1)/2 < n. Encode in bitvector precomputation.
experiment_seed: Measure OEE pruning rate independently and in combination with other sieves for N=40..60.
